I read another article albeit at 5 am, from the sporting news, which I’m coming around to they are just freelance hot take artists citing, this is it for Josh.  The last year to win it all.  If you ask for a reference go to the main page as it’s on there this morning at 5 am.



	 



	The writer cites another analyst measuring at 30 it’s his year do or die.  This to me is ridiculous.  I’ll use a tried and true, Elway lost three SBs early in his career, and then won at 37 and 38 against ATL and GB.  His helicopter play is legendary.  He also is compared to JA more than anyone.



	 



	Josh has another 8 years minimum to get to the dance.  I’ll never listen to these dumb rants.  I thought maybe some of you have your own opinions.  You can disagree as that is what we do here or agree.
